  • The producer values his product at $6 and sells it to a processor. The producer pays $1.50 in tax.

  • The processor values his product at $9 and sells it to a retailer. The processor pays $2.25 in tax.

  • The retailer values his product at $12 and sells it to a customer. In Seattle, Washington, the customer would pay a total of $16.32. $3.00 for the excise tax, $1.32 for the sales tax.
